unitTitle: The Expedition — Episode 2: The Jivaro Indians
scanNote: Oxirgi gap pufagi ('Yeah! It wanted to take some "snap" shots of the jungle.') kimga tegishli ekani rasmdan aniq ko'rinmaydi — pufakning dumi Devid va Sandra orasida. Mantiqan bu Devidning javobi (Sandra hazilni boshlagan, Devid davom ettirgan). Hikoyaning ma'nosiga bu ta'sir qilmaydi.

exercises.explanationUz:
OLDINGI EPIZODDA NIMA BO'LGAN EDI
(68-69-betlar, 1-epizod: 'The Waterfall'):

  Devid va Sandra — Londondan kelgan ikki
  jurnalist. Ular tropik o'rmonning yo'q
  qilinishi haqida maqola yozish uchun
  Amazonkaga ekspeditsiyaga chiqishgan.


2-EPIZOD: 'THE JIVARO INDIANS'
(Xivaro hindulari)

  XIVARO HINDULARI KIM:
  Ekvador va Peru tropik o'rmonlarida yashaydigan
  hindu xalqi. Ular o'z yerlarini himoya qilishi
  bilan mashhur.


EPIZODNING TUZILIShI — YETTI RASM:

  1  Daryoda — timsoh Devidga hujum qiladi
  2  'SNAP!' — Sandra unga eshkak uzatadi
  3  Daryo bo'yida — qutulishdi, lekin hindular
     paydo bo'ldi
  4  Notanish keksa odam — u mashhur Doktor
     Hamperdin ekan!
  5  Doktorning hikoyasi va jurnalistlarning
     maqsadi
  6  Doktor hindularni tushuntiradi va sirini
     saqlashni so'raydi
  7  Londonda — muharrir ularni maqtaydi


EPIZODNING ASOSIY MAVZUSI:
  Tropik o'rmonni HIMOYA QILISh.
  Xivaro hindulari o'z yerlarini, hayvonlarini
  va daraxtlarini saqlashadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR (epizoddan):
  an alligator     = timsoh (Amerika timsohi)
  to be after sb   = kimnidir quvmoq
  to hold on to    = mahkam ushlamoq
  a river bank     = daryo bo'yi, qirg'oq
  scary            = qo'rqinchli
  safe             = xavfsiz
  to panic         = vahimaga tushmoq
  nearly           = deyarli, sal bo'lmasa
  to save          = qutqarmoq
  a rainforest     = tropik o'rmon
  medicine         = dori
  a reporter       = jurnalist, muxbir
  destruction      = yo'q qilish, vayron qilish
  to hurt          = zarar yetkazmoq
  to follow        = ergashmoq, quvmoq
  land             = yer, mulk
  to cut down      = kesmoq (daraxt)
  to destroy       = vayron qilmoq
  to protect       = himoya qilmoq
  a snapshot       = tezkor surat

points.noteUz:
Xivaro — Ekvador va Peru tropik o'rmonlarida
yashaydigan hindu xalqi.

points.en: David and Sandra are reporters from London.
points.uz: Devid va Sandra — Londondan kelgan jurnalistlar.
points.noteUz:
Ular tropik o'rmonning yo'q qilinishi haqida
maqola yozish uchun kelishgan.

exercises.explanationUz:
BIRINChI UCh RASM — ENG KESKIN PAYT.

  1-RASM (daryo, timsoh suzib kelmoqda):
     SANDRA: 'David, over here!'
     DAVID:  'Sandra, help! An alligator is after
              me! My camera!'

  2-RASM ('SNAP!' — timsohning tishi):
     SANDRA: 'Forget your camera. Here, hold on to
              this.'
             (u Devidga eshkakni uzatadi)

  3-RASM (ON THE RIVER BANK — daryo bo'yida):
     DAVID:  'Phew! That was scary, but we're safe
              now.'
     SANDRA: 'I'm not so sure, David. The Indians
              are here.'


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Sandra: Devid, bu yoqqa!
  Devid:  Sandra, yordam ber! Timsoh meni
          quvyapti! Fotoapparatim!
  Sandra: Fotoapparatingni unut. Mana, buni
          mahkam ushla.
  Devid:  Uh! Qo'rqinchli edi, lekin endi
          xavfsizmiz.
  Sandra: Men unchalik ishonchim komil emas,
          Devid. Hindular bu yerda.


DIQQAT — 'SNAP' SO'ZINING IKKI MA'NOSI:
  Bu — butun epizodning HAZILI.

  1) SNAP! — timsohning tishini shaqillatishi
     (tovush taqlidi)
  2) a SNAPSHOT — tezkor surat, foto

  Epizodning OXIRIDA bu ikki ma'no birlashtiriladi
  ('It wanted to take some "snap" shots').


GRAMMATIK NUQTALAR:

  'An alligator IS AFTER me!'
     'be after sb' = kimnidir quvmoq, ta'qib qilmoq.
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS emas — 'be after' turg'un
     ibora.

  'HOLD ON TO this.'
     'hold on to' = mahkam ushlamoq.
     Buyruq gap — fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.

  'That WAS scary, but we're safe NOW.'
     Bir gapda IKKI zamon:
     'was' (o'tgan — timsoh voqeasi),
     'are' (hozirgi — endi xavfsiz).

  'I'm not SO SURE.'
     'so sure' = unchalik ishonchli emas.
     Muloyim shubha bildirish qolipi.

Sandra Devidni o'ziga chaqirmoqda.

sentences.noteUz:

'an alligator' = Amerika timsohi.

FOTOAPPARATI haqida qayg'urmoqda — bu

sentences.noteUz:

Sandra unga ESHKAKNI uzatmoqda.

sentences.noteUz:
Timsohning tishini shaqillatishi (tovush taqlidi).
DIQQAT: 'snap' so'zining IKKINCHI ma'nosi —

sentences.uz: DARYO BO'YIDA ...

sentences.uz: Devid: Uh! Qo'rqinchli edi, lekin endi xavfsizmiz.
sentences.noteUz:

Bir gapda IKKI zamon: 'WAS scary' (o'tgan) va
'ARE safe NOW' (hozirgi).

sentences.en: Sandra: I'm not so sure, David. The Indians are here.
sentences.uz: Sandra: Men unchalik ishonchim komil emas, Devid. Hindular bu yerda.
sentences.noteUz:
'I'm not so sure' = unchalik ishonchim komil emas.
Muloyim shubha bildirish qolipi.
Bu gap YANGI xavfni e'lon qiladi — hikoya
davom etadi.

exercises.explanationUz:
4-RASM (hindular nayza bilan; shlyapali keksa
odam):

     KEKSA ODAM: 'Don't be afraid. There is no need
                  to panic.'
     SANDRA:     'Who are you?'
     DAVID:      'Hey! I know you! You are the
                  famous Doctor Hamperdin.
                  Everybody thinks that you're
                  dead.'


5-RASM (doktor tushuntiradi):

     DOCTOR: 'Well, as you can see, I'm not! I
              NEARLY died, but these people found
              me and saved me. Now I live here with
              them. I'm their doctor. I'm learning
              about the plants of the rainforest.
              It is very interesting. The Jivaro
              Indians use some of the plants as
              medicine. But who are you? What are
              you doing here?'

     DAVID:  'We're reporters. We came here to
              write an article about the
              destruction of the rainforest.'


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Doktor: Qo'rqmanglar. Vahimaga tushishga hojat
          yo'q.
  Sandra: Siz kimsiz?
  Devid:  Hey! Men sizni bilaman! Siz mashhur
          Doktor Hamperdinsiz. Hamma sizni o'lgan
          deb o'ylaydi.

  Doktor: Ha, ko'rib turganingizdek, o'lganim yo'q!
          Sal bo'lmasa o'lardim, lekin bu odamlar
          meni topib, qutqarishdi. Endi men shu
          yerda ular bilan yashayman. Men ularning
          shifokoriman. Tropik o'rmon o'simliklari
          haqida o'rganyapman. Bu juda qiziqarli.
          Xivaro hindulari ba'zi o'simliklarni dori
          sifatida ishlatishadi. Lekin sizlar
          kimsiz? Bu yerda nima qilyapsizlar?

  Devid:  Biz jurnalistmiz. Biz bu yerga tropik
          o'rmonning yo'q qilinishi haqida maqola
          yozish uchun keldik.


HIKOYANING BURILISh NUQTASI:
  Hamma O'LGAN deb o'ylagan mashhur olim
  TIRIK ekan va hindular orasida yashar ekan.


GRAMMATIK NUQTALAR:

  'DON'T BE afraid.'
     'be' fe'lining INKOR buyruq shakli:
     DON'T + BE + sifat.

  'There is NO NEED TO panic.'
     'there is no need to ...' = ... ga hojat yo'q.

  'Everybody THINKS that you're dead.'
     'everybody' — BIRLIK → 'thinkS'.
     Bu — ko'p uchraydigan xato manbai.

  'I NEARLY died.'
     'nearly' = deyarli, sal bo'lmasa.
     'I nearly died' = sal bo'lmasa o'lardim
     (LEKIN o'lmadim).
     Kitob bu so'zni QALIN bergan — demak u
     keyingi mashqlarda so'raladi.

  'I'M LEARNING about the plants.'
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS — hozir davom etayotgan
     jarayon.

  'The Jivaro Indians USE some of the plants AS
   medicine.'
     'use sth AS sth' = ... ni ... sifatida
     ishlatmoq.

  'We CAME here TO WRITE an article.'
     'to write' — MAQSAD bildiradi
     (nima uchun kelishdi).

sentences.en: Doctor: Don't be afraid. There is no need to panic.
sentences.uz: Doktor: Qo'rqmanglar. Vahimaga tushishga hojat yo'q.
sentences.noteUz:
'DON'T BE + sifat' — 'be' fe'lining inkor buyrug'i.
'There is no need to ...' = ... ga hojat yo'q.
'to panic' = vahimaga tushmoq.

sentences.en: Sandra: Who are you?
sentences.uz: Sandra: Siz kimsiz?
sentences.noteUz: Oddiy 'be' savoli — 'did/do' KERAK EMAS.

sentences.en: David: Hey! I know you! You are the famous Doctor Hamperdin. Everybody thinks that you're dead.
sentences.uz: Devid: Hey! Men sizni bilaman! Siz mashhur Doktor Hamperdinsiz. Hamma sizni o'lgan deb o'ylaydi.
sentences.noteUz:
'EVERYBODY' — BIRLIK → 'thinkS' (-s bilan).
'everybody think' XATO.
Hikoyaning BURILISH nuqtasi: o'lgan deb
hisoblangan olim TIRIK.

sentences.en: Doctor: Well, as you can see, I'm not! I nearly died, but these people found me and saved me.
sentences.uz: Doktor: Ha, ko'rib turganingizdek, o'lganim yo'q! Sal bo'lmasa o'lardim, lekin bu odamlar meni topib, qutqarishdi.
sentences.noteUz:
'as you can see' = ko'rib turganingizdek.
'NEARLY died' = sal bo'lmasa o'lardi
(LEKIN o'lmadi). Kitob 'nearly' ni QALIN bergan.
find → FOUND, save → SAVED.

sentences.en: Doctor: Now I live here with them. I'm their doctor. I'm learning about the plants of the rainforest. It is very interesting.
sentences.uz: Doktor: Endi men shu yerda ular bilan yashayman. Men ularning shifokoriman. Tropik o'rmon o'simliklari haqida o'rganyapman. Bu juda qiziqarli.
sentences.noteUz:
'I LIVE here' — PRESENT SIMPLE (doimiy holat).
'I'M LEARNING' — PRESENT CONTINUOUS
(davom etayotgan jarayon).
Ikki zamon YONMA-YON — farqiga e'tibor bering.

sentences.en: Doctor: The Jivaro Indians use some of the plants as medicine. But who are you? What are you doing here?
sentences.uz: Doktor: Xivaro hindulari ba'zi o'simliklarni dori sifatida ishlatishadi. Lekin sizlar kimsiz? Bu yerda nima qilyapsizlar?
sentences.noteUz:
'use sth AS sth' = ... ni ... sifatida ishlatmoq.
'medicine' = dori (SANALMAYDIGAN ot).
'What are you DOING here?' — PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

sentences.en: David: We're reporters. We came here to write an article about the destruction of the rainforest.
sentences.uz: Devid: Biz jurnalistmiz. Biz bu yerga tropik o'rmonning yo'q qilinishi haqida maqola yozish uchun keldik.
sentences.noteUz:
'We came here TO WRITE ...' — 'to' MAQSAD
bildiradi (nima uchun kelishdi).
'destruction' = yo'q qilish ('to destroy' dan).
'a rainforest' = tropik o'rmon.

exercises.instructionEn: Panels 6-7: The Indians' land and back in London
exercises.explanationUz:
6-RASM (hindu Sandraning fotoapparatiga qo'l
uzatadi):

     SANDRA: 'Doctor, stop him! He wants to take my
              camera!'
     DOCTOR: 'Don't worry. He won't hurt you.'
     SANDRA: 'But why are they following us?'
     DOCTOR: 'The Jivaro Indians love their land.
              They don't want anyone to kill their
              animals, cut down their trees or
              destroy their homes. I can help you
              write your article and you can tell
              the world to protect the rainforest.
              But — don't tell anyone about me.
              I'm happy here. I don't want to go
              back.'


7-RASM (BACK IN LONDON — muharrir kabinetida):

     EDITOR: 'Good work, you two. This is a great
              story and the pictures are fantastic.'
     DAVID:  'Well, it wasn't very difficult. What
              do you think, Sandra?'
     SANDRA: 'Oh no, it wasn't. David needs a new
              camera, though. An alligator ate his
              old one!'
     DAVID:  'Yeah! It wanted to take some "snap"
              shots of the jungle.'


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Sandra: Doktor, uni to'xtating! U mening
          fotoapparatimni olmoqchi!
  Doktor: Xavotir olmang. U sizga zarar yetkazmaydi.
  Sandra: Lekin nega ular bizga ergashyapti?
  Doktor: Xivaro hindulari o'z yerlarini sevishadi.
          Ular hech kim hayvonlarini o'ldirishini,
          daraxtlarini kesishini yoki uylarini
          vayron qilishini xohlashmaydi. Men sizga
          maqolangizni yozishda yordam bera olaman,
          siz esa dunyoga tropik o'rmonni himoya
          qilishni aytishingiz mumkin. Lekin —
          men haqimda hech kimga aytmang. Men shu
          yerda baxtliman. Qaytib borishni
          xohlamayman.

  Muharrir: Zo'r ish, ikkalangiz. Bu ajoyib hikoya
            va suratlar zo'r.
  Devid:    Ha, unchalik qiyin bo'lmadi. Sen
            nima deb o'ylaysan, Sandra?
  Sandra:   Yo'q, qiyin bo'lmadi. Lekin Devidga
            yangi fotoapparat kerak. Timsoh
            eskisini yeb qo'ydi!
  Devid:    Ha! U jungli suratlarini olmoqchi edi!


HIKOYANING HAZILI — 'SNAP':
  'snap'  — timsohning tishini shaqillatishi
            (2-rasmdagi 'SNAP!')
  'snapshot' — tezkor surat

  Devid: 'It wanted to take some SNAP shots'
  = 'U SNAP suratlar olmoqchi edi'
  Ikki ma'no bir vaqtda: timsoh 'shaq' etdi
  VA 'surat oldi'.

  Bu — SO'Z O'YINI (pun) deyiladi.


GRAMMATIK NUQTALAR:

  'He WON'T hurt you.'
     'won't' = 'will not' — KELASI zamon inkori.
     Doktor ishontirmoqda.

  'Why ARE they FOLLOWING us?'
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS — hozir sodir bo'layotgan.

  'They DON'T WANT ANYONE TO kill ...'
     'want sb TO do sth' = kimnidir ... qilishini
     xohlamoq.
     'anyone' — INKOR gapda ('someone' emas).

  'I CAN HELP YOU WRITE your article.'
     'help sb (to) do sth' — 'to' TUSHIRIB
     QOLDIRILADI.
     'help you to write' ham to'g'ri.

  'you can TELL the world TO PROTECT ...'
     'tell sb TO do sth' = kimgadir ... qilishni
     aytmoq.

  'DON'T TELL ANYONE about me.'
     INKOR buyruq + 'anyone'.

  'An alligator ATE his old ONE!'
     eat → ATE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
     'his old ONE' = 'his old camera' o'rniga.

  'It wasn't very difficult.' / 'Oh no, it wasn't.'
     Sandra Devidning kamtarligini TASDIQLAYDI —
     lekin keyin darrov timsoh voqeasini aytadi
     (ya'ni aslida QIYIN edi). Bu ham hazil.


EPIZODNING XABARI:
  Tropik o'rmonni HIMOYA QILISh kerak.
  Xivaro hindulari o'z yerini, hayvonlarini va
  daraxtlarini asrashadi — jurnalistlar bu haqda
  dunyoga aytishi kerak.

sentences.en: Sandra: Doctor, stop him! He wants to take my camera!
sentences.uz: Sandra: Doktor, uni to'xtating! U mening fotoapparatimni olmoqchi!
sentences.noteUz:
'stop him' — buyruq gap.

sentences.en: Doctor: Don't worry. He won't hurt you.
sentences.uz: Doktor: Xavotir olmang. U sizga zarar yetkazmaydi.
sentences.noteUz:
'won't' = 'will not' — KELASI zamon inkori.
'to hurt' = zarar yetkazmoq (noto'g'ri fe'l:
hurt - hurt - hurt).

sentences.en: Sandra: But why are they following us?
sentences.uz: Sandra: Lekin nega ular bizga ergashyapti?
sentences.noteUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — hozir sodir bo'layotgan.
'to follow' = ergashmoq (predlogSIZ:
'follow us', 'follow to us' XATO).

sentences.en: Doctor: The Jivaro Indians love their land. They don't want anyone to kill their animals, cut down their trees or destroy their homes.
sentences.uz: Doktor: Xivaro hindulari o'z yerlarini sevishadi. Ular hech kim hayvonlarini o'ldirishini, daraxtlarini kesishini yoki uylarini vayron qilishini xohlashmaydi.
sentences.noteUz:
'want sb TO do sth' — qolip.
'ANYONE' — INKOR gapda ('someone' emas).
'cut down' = kesmoq (daraxt).
'to destroy' = vayron qilmoq.
Uch fe'l bitta 'to' bilan: to kill, cut down,
destroy.

sentences.en: Doctor: I can help you write your article and you can tell the world to protect the rainforest.
sentences.uz: Doktor: Men sizga maqolangizni yozishda yordam bera olaman, siz esa dunyoga tropik o'rmonni himoya qilishni aytishingiz mumkin.
sentences.noteUz:
'help sb (TO) do sth' — 'to' TUSHIRILADI.
'tell sb TO do sth' — bu yerda 'to' KERAK.
'to protect' = himoya qilmoq.
Bu — epizodning ASOSIY XABARI.

sentences.en: Doctor: But — don't tell anyone about me. I'm happy here. I don't want to go back.
sentences.uz: Doktor: Lekin — men haqimda hech kimga aytmang. Men shu yerda baxtliman. Qaytib borishni xohlamayman.
sentences.noteUz:
'DON'T TELL ANYONE' — inkor buyruq + 'anyone'.
Doktor o'z SIRINI saqlashni so'ramoqda.
'to go back' = qaytib bormoq.

sentences.en: BACK IN LONDON ... Editor: Good work, you two. This is a great story and the pictures are fantastic.
sentences.uz: LONDONGA QAYTIB ... Muharrir: Zo'r ish, ikkalangiz. Bu ajoyib hikoya va suratlar zo'r.
sentences.noteUz:
'you two' = ikkalangiz.
'Good work' — maqtov iborasi.
Hikoya Londondagi tahririyatda tugaydi.

sentences.noteUz:
Devid KAMTARLIK qilmoqda.
'What do you think?' — fikr so'rash.

sentences.noteUz:
'though' = lekin (gap OXIRIDA turadi).
eat → ATE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'his old ONE' = 'his old camera' o'rniga.
Sandra hazil bilan haqiqatni ochib qo'ymoqda.

sentences.en: David: Yeah! It wanted to take some "snap" shots of the jungle.
sentences.uz: Devid: Ha! U jungli suratlarini olmoqchi edi!
sentences.noteUz:
EPIZODNING HAZILI — SO'Z O'YINI:
'SNAP!' — timsohning shaqillashi (2-rasmda)
'a SNAPSHOT' — tezkor surat
Ikki ma'no bir vaqtda ishlatilmoqda.
'take a photo/shot' = surat olmoq.
